scope: SPY research only, daily regular session. Ex ante motivation is Lucca and Moench NY Fed SR512; the product's open-to-close target covers only part of their prior-24-hour interval. The earlier product screen studied decision days and OPEX in 2026. This study ends in 2025 before that experiment. Some historical price targets may overlap other SPY research.
sample: Use all ten annual schedules for target years 2016 through 2025 inclusive, as published by the FOMC in the year before the target year. Use the eight initial scheduled meeting end dates for each year, not the future realised calendar. Include an announced date even if an extraordinary subsequent change occurred. It is an original-calendar marker. Use the prior scheduled regular exchange session as treated day. Match the same weekday exactly seven calendar days earlier as control; require both days and their immediately preceding exchange sessions to be full, with unique dates and no control equal to any treatment. Never replace a missing pair.
data: Official press-release HTML and an independent publication of the same announcement (Board printable PDF when available or Federal Reserve contemporary archived release where available), or a check against the Board's realised calendar as a diagnostic, never as a selector. Verify year of dated announcement earlier than all targets, exact eight decision dates, and original weekday/source identity. Record any discrepancies versus the final calendar separately. Reuse existing extended exchange calendar and bound all rows before first public forecast.
features: The single control is the signed natural log return from the immediately prior complete regular-session open to close. Model A uses the control alone. Model B uses that same control and the original-calendar eve flag (1 or 0). Hypothesis: the incremental eve coefficient is positive. One comparison, no tuning sample, alternative lags, subgroups, instruments or horizons.
outcomes: As-traded and split-only Kibot bars must agree on sign for each target and prior session; omit both arms when either side fails. Target = 1 if regular-session close exceeds open, otherwise 0. Verify source OHLC, clocks, integrity and privacy. Use issuance at 07:48 New York and known time at actual close. No production/private holdout reservations are used.
evaluation: Require >=120 distinct matched total target dates; use the existing chronological purged 60/20/20 trainCandidate with >=20 test targets. Report treatment/control counts, Brier errors against lagged-return alone, train base rate and 0.50. Incremental slope must be positive and Brier must improve by >0.01 over each baseline. Show prelaunch research output only. No automatic family vote or model promotion. No repeat trials after opening labels.
